verses.sloka: एवं ब्रुवति रामे तु लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा ।प्रत्युवाच महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा ।। ७.५८.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ bruvati rāme tu lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā ।pratyuvāca mahātmānaṁ jvalantamiva tejasā ।। 7.58.1 ॥

translations.english: While Rama was speaking thus, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy heroes, replied to the great-souled Rama, who was shining as if blazing with splendor.
translations.hindi: उत्तरकाण्ड का छियालीसवाँ सगे पूरा हुआ । —१-%8-:— —B— [ टिप्पणी द्यपि ४६ वें सगै को समाप्त करते हए ग्रादिकवि ने एक ही श्लोक में लक्ष्मण का श्रोग [ जो के पार दोना लिख गद्श्रा हे, तथापि इस सगा म श्रोगङ्गा जी के पार हाने का वणुन विस्तार से किग्रा है । ] अथ नाव सावस्ताणा नपाद रावभानुजः आरुतह सपायुक्ता पूवमाराप्य साथिलीस

verses.sloka: महदद्भुतमाश्चर्यं विदेहस्य पुरातनम् ।निर्वृत्तं राजशार्दूल वसिष्ठस्य निमेस्सह ।। ७.५८.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahadadbhutamāścaryaṁ videhasya purātanam ।nirvṛttaṁ rājaśārdūla vasiṣṭhasya nimessaha ।। 7.58.2 ॥

translations.english: O tiger among kings, a great and ancient astonishing event concerning Videha occurred involving Vasishtha and Nimi.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर सुमंत्र से कहा-“तुम रथ सहित इसी पार रहो।” फिर शोकाळुल हो सल्लाहो से कहा कि--“नाव चलाओ”'

verses.sloka: निमिस्तु क्षत्रियः शूरो विशेषेण च दीक्षितः ।न क्षमां कृतवान्राजा वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः ।। ७.५८.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: nimistu kṣatriyaḥ śūro viśeṣeṇa ca dīkṣitaḥ ।na kṣamāṁ kṛtavānrājā vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 7.58.3 ॥

translations.english: But King Nimi, a brave Kshatriya who was especially initiated into a sacrifice, did not show forgiveness towards the great-souled Vasishtha.
translations.hindi: ।गङ्गा जी के उस पार ५हुँच कर, लक्ष्मण जी आँखों में आंसू भर, गद्गद्‌ कण्ठ से सीता जी से बोले

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तस्तु तेनायं श्रीमान् क्षत्रियपुङ्गवः ।उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं सर्वशास्त्रविशारदम् ।। ७.५८.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktastu tenāyaṁ śrīmān kṣatriyapuṅgavaḥ ।uvāca lakṣmaṇaṁ vākyaṁ sarvaśāstraviśāradam ।। 7.58.4 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by him (Lakshmana), the glorious Rama, the best among Kshatriyas, spoke words to Lakshmana, who was skilled in all scriptures.
translations.hindi: हे विदेहकुमारी ! ऐसे बुद्धि मान महाराज ने इस निन्द्यकर्म में मुझे नियुक्त कर, मुझे संसार में निन्दा का पात्र बनाया है । इसलिए यह कार्ये मेरे हृदय में कांटे कीं तरह चुभ रहा हे

verses.sloka: रामो रमयतां श्रेष्ठो भ्रातरं दीप्ततेजसम् ।न सर्वत्र क्षमा वीर पुरुषेषु प्रदृश्यते ।। ७.५८.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāmo ramayatāṁ śreṣṭho bhrātaraṁ dīptatejasam ।na sarvatra kṣamā vīra puruṣeṣu pradṛśyate ।। 7.58.5 ॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among those who delight, addresses his brother of blazing splendor, stating that forgiveness is not always observed among all men, O hero.
translations.hindi: ऐसे लोकनिन्दित काम करने की अपेक्षा तो, यदि i जाता तो बहुत हौ अच्छा था । मेरे लिए बड़ा अच्छा होता, दमै में फासा जाता

verses.sloka: सौमित्रे दुःसहो रोषो यथा क्षान्तो ययातिना ।सत्त्वानुगं पुरस्कृत्य तन्निबोध समाहितः ।। ७.५८.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: saumitre duḥsaho roṣo yathā kṣānto yayātinā ।sattvānugaṁ puraskṛtya tannibodha samāhitaḥ ।। 7.58.6 ॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, understand with a concentrated mind how the unbearable anger was endured by Yayati, considering the path of virtue.
translations.hindi: Sw तिला ne oe करको चह न्रा वटी सस: हे वत्स ! तुमको महाराज की शपथ है। बतलाओ तुम्हारे इस मकार सन्तप्त होने का कारण क्या हे ? में तुम्हें आज्ञा देती हूँ

verses.sloka: नहुषस्य सुतो राजा ययातिः पौरवर्धनः ।तस्य भार्याद्वयं सौम्य रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि ।। ७.५८.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: nahuṣasya suto rājā yayātiḥ pauravardhanaḥ ।tasya bhāryādvayaṁ saumya rūpeṇāpratimaṁ bhuvi ।। 7.58.7 ॥

translations.english: O gentle one, King Yayati, the son of Nahusha and augmenter of the Paurava lineage, had two wives whose beauty was unequalled on earth.
translations.hindi: जब लक्ष्मण जी दाथ जोड़े, प्रथिजी पर्‌ गिर कर अपना मरना मनाने लगे,तब सीता ने लक्ष्मण जी की ऐसी दशा देख, अत्यन्त घबडा कर उनसे कहा

verses.sloka: एका तु तस्य राजर्षेर्नाहुषस्य पुरस्कृता ।शर्मिष्ठा नाम दैतेयी दुहिता वृषपर्वणः ।। ७.५८.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: ekā tu tasya rājarṣernāhuṣasya puraskṛtā ।śarmiṣṭhā nāma daiteyī duhitā vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ ।। 7.58.8 ॥

translations.english: One of those wives, honored by the royal sage Yayati, son of Nahusha, was named Sharmishtha, the daughter of the Daitya king Vrishaparvan.
translations.hindi: इति सप्तचत्वारिंशः सगे: ॥ र $ हे सीते ! तुम श्रीरामचंद्र जी का अपने हृदय में ध्यान करती हुई, पातित्रतधर्स का पालन करना । बस इससे तुम्हारा परम कल्याण होगा

verses.sloka: अन्या तूशनसः पत्नी ययातेः पुरुषर्षभ ।न तु सा दयिता राज्ञो देवयानी सुमध्यमा ।। ७.५८.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: anyā tūśanasaḥ patnī yayāteḥ puruṣarṣabha ।na tu sā dayitā rājño devayānī sumadhyamā ।। 7.58.9 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, the other wife of Yayati was Devayani, the daughter of Ushanas, but that slender-waisted Devayani was not beloved by the king.

verses.sloka: तयोः पुत्रौ तु सम्भूतौ रूपवन्तौ समाहितौ ।शर्मिष्ठा ऽजनयत्पूरुं देवयानी यदुं तदा ।। ७.५८.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ putrau tu sambhūtau rūpavantau samāhitau ।śarmiṣṭhā 'janayatpūruṁ devayānī yaduṁ tadā ।। 7.58.10 ॥

translations.english: Then, two handsome and well-composed sons were born to them; Sharmishtha gave birth to Puru, and Devayani gave birth to Yadu.
translations.hindi: जब सीता जी ने इस प्रकार शपथ दी, तब लक्ष्मण जी बड़े न हो, नीचे को सु ह्‌ कर, गद्गद्‌ कण्ठ से यह बोले

verses.sloka: पूरुस्तु दयितो राज्ञो गुणैर्मातृकृतेन च ।ततो दुःखसमाविष्टो यदुर्मातरमब्रवीत् ।। ७.५८.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: pūrustu dayito rājño guṇairmātṛkṛtena ca ।tato duḥkhasamāviṣṭo yadurmātaramabravīt ।। 7.58.11 ॥

translations.english: Puru was beloved by the king due to his qualities and his mother's situation, so Yadu, filled with sorrow, then spoke to his mother.
translations.hindi: छ हे जनकनन्दिनी ! राजधानी आर राज्य भर में तुम्हारे संबंध में जो महादारुण अपवाद फैला हुआ है, उसे सभा में सुन,

verses.sloka: भार्गवस्य कुले जाता देवस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ।सहसे हृद्गतं दुःखमवमानं च दुःसहम् ।। ७.५८.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhārgavasya kule jātā devasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ ।sahase hṛdgataṁ duḥkhamavamānaṁ ca duḥsaham ।। 7.58.12 ॥

translations.english: Yadu questioned his mother, Devayani, born in the lineage of the divine Bhrigu whose deeds are unblemished, asking why she endures such deep-seated sorrow and unbearable insult.
translations.hindi: रामः सन्तपृहृदयो मां निवेध गृहं गतः ¦ न तानि बचनीयानि मया देवि तवाग्र |) १२ ॥ श्रीरामचंद्र जी बड़े दुःखी हुए और मुझे समस्त वृत्तान्त बतला राजभवन में चले गए। हे देवि! वे सब बातें, तुम्हारे सामने कहने योग्य नहीं हैं

verses.sloka: आवां च सहितौ देवि प्रविशाव हुताशनम् ।राजा तु रमतां सार्धं दैत्यपुत्र्या बहुक्षपाः ।। ७.५८.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: āvāṁ ca sahitau devi praviśāva hutāśanam ।rājā tu ramatāṁ sārdhaṁ daityaputryā bahukṣapāḥ ।। 7.58.13 ॥

translations.english: Yadu proposed to his mother, "O goddess, let us both enter the fire together, while the king enjoys himself with the Daitya's daughter for many nights."
translations.hindi: महाराज ने उनको अपने मन ही में छिपा कर रखा ह्वै । मेने उन्हें सुना अनसुना कर दिया है । (उन बातों का सारांश डेर यह्‌ है कि) महाराज ने तुम्हारा त्याग किआ है। किन्तु मेरी # पाठान्तरे--“बाष्पकलं ।” बा० रा? उ०.-~-३६ दृष्टि में तम सर्वथा निर्दोष हो अथवा महाराज ने मेरे सामने तमको निर्दोष बतलाया है

verses.sloka: यदि वा सहनीयं ते मामनुज्ञातुमर्हसि ।क्षम त्वं न क्षमिष्ये ऽहं मरिष्यामि न संशयः ।। ७.५८.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi vā sahanīyaṁ te māmanujñātumarhasi ।kṣama tvaṁ na kṣamiṣye 'haṁ mariṣyāmi na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.58.14 ॥

translations.english: Yadu continued, "If this is bearable for you, then you should permit me; you may endure it, but I will not, and I will surely die."

verses.sloka: पुत्रस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा परमार्तस्य रोदतः ।देवयानी तु सङ्क्रुद्धा सस्मार पितरं तदा ।। ७.५८.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: putrasya bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā paramārtasya rodataḥ ।devayānī tu saṅkruddhā sasmāra pitaraṁ tadā ।। 7.58.15 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of her greatly distressed and weeping son, Devayani became exceedingly enraged and then remembered her father.

verses.sloka: इङ्गितं तदभिज्ञाय दुहितुर्भार्गवस्तदा ।आगतस्त्वरितं तत्र देवयानी तु यत्र सा ।। ७.५८.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: iṅgitaṁ tadabhijñāya duhiturbhārgavastadā ।āgatastvaritaṁ tatra devayānī tu yatra sā ।। 7.58.16 ॥

translations.english: Then, understanding that sign of his daughter, Bhargava quickly came to where Devayani was.
translations.hindi: जो अतिरम्य और पवित्र है, सें तसको त्यागँगा । तम यहीं रहना और शोक न करना । हे शुभे ! मेरे पिता महाराज दश- रथ के मनिश्रेष्ठ, महायशस्वी विप्र वाल्मीकि बड़े मित्र हैं। हे सीते ! अतः तुम उन्हीं महात्मा के चरणों में पहुँच, सावधानता पूवक उनकी सेवा करती हुई सुख से रहना

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा चाप्रकृतिस्थां तामप्रहृष्टामचेतनाम् ।पिता दुहितरं वाक्यं किमेतदिति चाब्रवीत् ।। ७.५८.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā cāprakṛtisthāṁ tāmaprahṛṣṭāmacetanām ।pitā duhitaraṁ vākyaṁ kimetaditi cābravīt ।। 7.58.17 ॥

translations.english: And having seen her in a disturbed, unhappy, and distraught state, the father spoke to his daughter, asking, "What is this?"

verses.sloka: पृच्छन्तमसकृत्तं वै भार्गवं दीप्ततेजसम् ।देवयानी तु सङ्क्रुद्धा पितरं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ७.५८.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛcchantamasakṛttaṁ vai bhārgavaṁ dīptatejasam ।devayānī tu saṅkruddhā pitaraṁ vākyamabravīt ।। 7.58.18 ॥

translations.english: To that Bhargava of blazing splendor, who was repeatedly asking her, Devayani, greatly enraged, indeed spoke these words to her father.

verses.sloka: अहमग्निं विषं तीक्ष्णमपो वा मुनिसत्तम ।भक्षयिष्ये प्रवेक्ष्यामि न तु शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम् ।। ७.५८.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ahamagniṁ viṣaṁ tīkṣṇamapo vā munisattama ।bhakṣayiṣye pravekṣyāmi na tu śakṣyāmi jīvitum ।। 7.58.19 ॥

translations.english: O best of sages, I will consume fire or potent poison, or I will enter water, but I will not be able to live.

verses.sloka: न मां त्वमवजानीषे दुःखितामवमानिताम् ।वृक्षस्यावज्ञया ब्रह्मंश्छिद्यन्ते वृक्षजीविनः ।। ७.५८.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: na māṁ tvamavajānīṣe duḥkhitāmavamānitām ।vṛkṣasyāvajñayā brahmaṁśchidyante vṛkṣajīvinaḥ ।। 7.58.20 ॥

translations.english: Indrani complains to Chyavana that Nahusha disregards her, who is distressed and humiliated, just as tree-dwellers are destroyed by disrespecting the tree.

verses.sloka: अवज्ञया च राजर्षिः परिभूय च भार्गव ।मय्यवज्ञां प्रयुङ्क्ते हि न च मां बहु मन्यते ।। ७.५८.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: avajñayā ca rājarṣiḥ paribhūya ca bhārgava ।mayyavajñāṁ prayuṅkte hi na ca māṁ bahu manyate ।। 7.58.21 ॥

translations.english: Indrani further complains to Chyavana, stating that the royal sage Nahusha, having insulted her, indeed shows disrespect towards her and does not regard her highly.

verses.sloka: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कोपेनाभिपरिप्लुतः ।व्याहर्तुमुपचक्राम भार्गवो नहुषात्मजम् ।। ७.५८.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṁ śrutvā kopenābhipariplutaḥ ।vyāhartumupacakrāma bhārgavo nahuṣātmajam ।। 7.58.22 ॥

translations.english: Having heard her words, Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, was overwhelmed with anger and began to speak to Nahusha.

verses.sloka: यस्मान्मामवजानीषे नाहुष त्वं दुरात्मवान् ।जरया परया जीर्णः शैथिल्यमुपयास्यसि ।। ७.५८.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: yasmānmāmavajānīṣe nāhuṣa tvaṁ durātmavān ।jarayā parayā jīrṇaḥ śaithilyamupayāsyasi ।। 7.58.23 ॥

translations.english: Chyavana cursed Nahusha, declaring that because the evil-minded Nahusha disregarded him, he would become extremely worn out by old age and attain great weakness.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा दुहितरं समाश्वास्य च भार्गवः ।पुनर्जगाम ब्रह्मर्षिर्भवनं स्वं महायशाः ।। ७.५८.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā duhitaraṁ samāśvāsya ca bhārgavaḥ ।punarjagāma brahmarṣirbhavanaṁ svaṁ mahāyaśāḥ ।। 7.58.24 ॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken and comforted his daughter, the highly renowned Brahmarshi Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu, returned to his own abode.

verses.sloka: स एवमुक्त्वा द्विजपुङ्गवाग्र्यः सुतां समाश्वास्य च देवयानीम् ।पुनर्ययौ सूर्यसमानतेजा दत्त्वा च शापं नहुषात्मजाय ।। ७.५८.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa evamuktvā dvijapuṅgavāgryaḥ sutāṁ samāśvāsya ca devayānīm ।punaryayau sūryasamānatejā dattvā ca śāpaṁ nahuṣātmajāya ।। 7.58.25 ।।

translations.english: Having thus spoken, the foremost Brahmin Shukra, after consoling his daughter Devayani and cursing Yayati, the son of Nahusha, departed again with a splendor like the sun. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 58 ।। Thus ends the fifty-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
